fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-12-04, Latha Sekar discovered that copper cables and fittings had been taken from a place near Senthil Garden Main Street in Salem. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-04 around 21:55 hrs. Chithra Raman (9000000126) reported the matter for Latha Sekar, whose contact number is given as 9000000043. The complaint mentions Mohan Ramasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000458, in connection with the events. Praveen Natarajan (9000000041) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
